title: About Ruptured Brand-Gallery Lightbox
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 165 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 3 and @giveashitnature: Minnesota pays residents to rip out their lawns and replace them with native..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Ruptured Brand-Gallery Lightbox: Ruptured brand-gallery lightbox, product-photo rupture, side-lit object slab: an impossible white editorial acrylic page buckles upward across a clean 16:9 field. Dark abstract masthead slabs crush the top third; below, a strict three-column gallery rhythm survives as burned-in source surfaces, cropped at the lower... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against cropped black masthead slab along the top edge, central buckled white fracture ridge, and upper-left glossy blue photo pocket.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
